ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: letters and numbers
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: learn letters and numbers properly

plain.li: I want to read every book in the colony. There are only four, but some of them are long.
I can write my name now. Next I'm going to write everybody's name, and then some long words.
[sparked] I saw the grown-ups reading and it looked like magic, so I'm going to learn the magic.

cheerful.li: I can count to a hundred! Next I'm going to count to a thousand, and then read.

gloomy.li: The letters keep moving about when I look at them. I'm going to make them stop.

blunt.li: Going to learn to read. Properly.

plain.li: I read a whole page today without asking anyone. It was about soil. I didn't care, I read it.
I can do sums faster than some grown-ups now. I'm not saying which ones.

cheerful.li: I can read! Signs and labels and the backs of crates, everything.

cold.li: I can read and reckon now. It is extremely useful and I don't understand why everyone doesn't.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: something growing of my own
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: grow something from seed, start to finish

plain.li: I'm going to grow the biggest vegetable anyone has ever seen. First I have to learn how.
I planted a seed in a cup and it came up. Now I want a whole row.
[spring] Everything's coming up green. I want some of it to be mine.

cheerful.li: I'm going to have my own garden, with a fence for keeping out the chickens!

gloomy.li: My seed didn't come up. I'm going to find out why, and then it'll come up.

warm.li: I want to grow something and give it to everyone at supper.

plain.li: The grown-ups let me have my own row, and everything in it came up. I check on it every morning.
I grew a vegetable and it was in the soup and everyone ate it. My vegetable.

cheerful.li: My plants are growing taller than me! Well, nearly.

warm.li: I grew something, and it fed people. That's the best thing I've ever done.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a den of my own
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: learn to build a proper den

plain.li: I want to build a den. A real one, with a roof that doesn't fall on you. I've been watching how the builders do it.
My den fell down again. I'm going to learn how walls work, and then it won't.

cheerful.li: I'm going to build a castle! A small one. For me and maybe one friend.

blunt.li: Going to build things. Big things. Later. Small things first.

gloomy.li: Everything I build falls down. Not for long, though.

plain.li: My den has a roof that stays up and a door that shuts. I built it all myself. Mostly myself.
One of the builders said my wall was straight. I'm going to remember that forever.

cheerful.li: My den is finished and it's the best den ever built!

cold.li: My structure has remained standing for nine days. I consider the problem solved.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: an animal of my very own
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: have a pet that comes when called
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: has a pet that comes when called

plain.li: I want an animal that's mine. Not the colony's. Mine. That comes when I call.
I've been saving scraps from supper. When an animal picks me, I'll be ready.
[sparked] Someone's dog follows them everywhere. I want one that follows me everywhere.

cheerful.li: I'm going to have a pet and name it something brilliant! I've got a list of names already.

warm.li: I'd look after an animal really well. Feed it and keep it warm and be its friend.

gloomy.li: The animals all like somebody else better. I'm going to change that.

plain.li: It comes when I call. It sleeps by my bed. It's mine, and I'm its.
I have my very own animal now, and I'm going to take care of it better than anyone has ever taken care of anything.

cheerful.li: I have a best friend with four legs! Five if you count the tail. I count the tail.

warm.li: My animal and I look after each other. It's the most important job I have.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: making them proud
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make the grown-ups proud

plain.li: I want the grown-ups to look at me the way they look at the best of them. Like I'm someone.
I'm going to be so good and so useful that everybody says my name at supper.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make everyone proud of me! I've already started. I helped with the washing.

gloomy.li: Nobody notices me. I'm going to make them notice.

warm.li: I want the grown-ups to be glad I'm here.

plain.li: One of the grown-ups called me "a credit to the colony" today. I asked what it meant. It means good.
They talk about me at supper now. The nice kind of talking.

cheerful.li: Everybody's proud of me, and I'm proud of me too!

warm.li: The grown-ups are glad I'm here. They told me so.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a grown-up's work
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: be trusted with a grown-up's work in {SKILL}
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: was trusted with a grown-up's work

plain.li: Always the easy jobs. I'll get good enough at {SKILL} that they have to give me the hard ones.
I want to be the one they ask, not the one they ask to fetch the one they ask.
[sparked] They wouldn't let me near the real work today. Fine. I'll be so good they can't stop me.

blunt.li: {SKILL}. I'm going to be good at it. Then they'll stop treating me like a child.

cheerful.li: One day I'll be the colony's best at {SKILL}! Starting with being decent at it.

gloomy.li: Nobody trusts the young with anything that matters. I'll have to earn it twice over.

cold.li: Competence is the only argument the grown-ups accept. I will make it in {SKILL}.

plain.li: They gave me a real job in {SKILL} today, the kind they give the grown-ups. Nobody checked my work afterward.
Someone came to me with a {SKILL} problem today. To me. On purpose.

blunt.li: They trust me with the real work now. About time.

cheerful.li: I'm trusted with grown-up work! I'm trying very hard not to show off.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: taken seriously
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: be taken seriously by the grown-ups
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: was taken seriously by the grown-ups

plain.li: When I talk at supper, the grown-ups smile and carry on with what they were saying. I want them to stop and listen.
I've got ideas. Good ones. If only somebody would hear them without patting me on the head.
[sparked] They decided it all without asking me. Next time they'll ask. I'll make sure of it.

blunt.li: I want the grown-ups to listen to me. Properly.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be so sensible that the grown-ups will ask ME for advice!

gloomy.li: They'll still think of me as a child when I'm forty. Unless I give them a reason not to.

plain.li: One of the grown-ups asked what I thought, and then waited for the answer. Then did what I said.
They argue with me now, instead of humoring me. I count that as winning.

cheerful.li: The grown-ups listen to me now, even the grumpy ones!

cold.li: My opinion is now weighed rather than tolerated. Satisfactory.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: past the hills
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see what lies past the hills
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw what lies past the hills

plain.li: I've never been further than the edge of the fields. Next caravan out, I'm asking to go along.
There's a whole world past those hills and I've only ever heard about it. I want to see it.

cheerful.li: I'm going on a journey, a real one, with a pack and everything!

gloomy.li: I'll be old before they let me leave the walls. I'll go anyway, one day.

blunt.li: Want to see the world. Or at least the next valley.

plain.li: I've been past the hills. There's another valley, and then more hills. Now I need to see what's past those.
Five days on the road. My feet are ruined and I've never been happier.

cheerful.li: I've seen the world! Well, a bit of it. The best bit, probably.

gloomy.li: I went past the hills, and home looks smaller now. I don't know if that's good.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: first love
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: fall in love for the first time
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: fell in love for the first time

plain.li: Everyone in the songs falls in love. I'd like to know what it's like, before I'm old.
[sparked] At the wedding I couldn't stop watching how they held hands. I'd like someone to hold mine like that.

cheerful.li: I want to fall in love! Not with anyone in particular. Yet.

gloomy.li: Nobody's ever going to fall for me. I'd like to be wrong about that.

warm.li: I'd like to love somebody, and be good to them, and have them be good to me.

plain.li: So this is what the songs are about. They didn't get it right. They didn't get it nearly right enough.
I'm in love, and they love me back, and I keep forgetting what I came into rooms for.

cheerful.li: I'm in love, everyone can tell, and I don't care!

gloomy.li: I'm in love. I'm terrified. I wouldn't change it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: to see them grown
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see a child they love grown up
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw a child they love grown up

plain.li: [!inherited] I'd like to see {NAME} grown. That's all. Just to see the grown-up {NAME} becomes.
[sparked,!inherited] This week set me counting the years I might have left. I want enough of them to see {NAME} grow up.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted to see the little one grown. I'll do the watching for both of us.

warm.li: I won't see everything the young ones do. I'd like to see the start, at least.

gloomy.li: I'm racing the years now. I'd like to win this one.

cold.li: I would like to observe how the child turns out. It is a reasonable thing to want.

plain.li: The child I worried over is grown, and grown well. I can rest easy about that, at least.
I saw them come of age. They looked at me across the table like an equal. Worth every year.

warm.li: They're grown, and kind with it. I had some small part in that.

gloomy.li: I lived to see it. I didn't think I would.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: one last fine piece
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make one last thing worth keeping
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: made one last thing worth keeping

plain.li: My hands aren't what they were. I'd like them to make one more fine thing before they stop, something the colony keeps.
[sparked] I've been wondering what's left of a person once they're gone. It ought to be something better than a few tools.
[inherited] {NAME} never made that last fine piece. I'll make it, and put {NAME}'s mark on it next to mine.

warm.li: Something to leave behind that people will use and think, someone made this with care.

blunt.li: One more good piece. Then I'll rest.

gloomy.li: My hands shake. I'll make one fine thing anyway, while they still do as they're told.

cold.li: I wish to leave one object of real quality. It is a practical form of memory.

plain.li: Finished it. The best thing I've made in years, maybe ever. It'll be here when I'm not.
I made something fine today. I sat and looked at it for a long while, and then I let them take it away to use.

warm.li: Somebody will use it every day long after I'm gone.

gloomy.li: I knew while I was making it that it would be my last fine piece. It's good.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: no grudge to the grave
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make peace with an old rival before the end
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: made peace with an old rival

plain.li: I don't want to take a grudge into the ground with me. There's someone I need to make peace with, while there's time.
[sparked] With death so close this week, the old quarrel looked very small. I want it finished.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted to die with no grudges, and didn't manage it. I'll settle mine while I still can.

warm.li: Life's too short for old quarrels, and mine is getting shorter. I want to put this one down.

blunt.li: One old quarrel to settle. Then I'm square with everyone.

gloomy.li: I'm running out of time to say sorry. I'd better say it.

plain.li: We made our peace, the two of us. Neither of us could remember what the fight was about.
No grudges left. I'm lighter than I've been in years.

warm.li: We shook hands and meant it. I can go whenever I go, now, with nothing owing.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: family set right
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: set things right with family

plain.li: There are things between me and my family that should have been mended years ago. I'd like to mend them while I can.
[sparked] A week like this one makes you count who you'd want at your bedside. I want my family there, and glad to be.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted the family at peace. I'll see to it.

warm.li: Family is family. Before I'm gone, we're going to sit at one table, all of us.

blunt.li: Going to fix things with my family. Overdue.

gloomy.li: Too many years, too many hard words. I'll try anyway.

cold.li: Unresolved family disputes are a poor legacy. I intend to resolve them.

plain.li: All of us at one table, and every one of them glad to be there. I didn't think I'd see it.
My family and I are at peace. Whatever comes, they'll remember me kindly.

warm.li: We're a family again, properly. I cried at supper, and somebody passed me the bread without a word.

gloomy.li: We mended it. I wish I hadn't waited so long.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: faith found again
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: find faith again

plain.li: I used to be sure of what I believed. Somewhere along the way I stopped being sure. I want it back.
[sparked] Whatever this week was, it sent me looking for my faith again. It's the only thing that ever helped.
[spark:omen] My dream came true, and I don't know what to make of it except that I should start listening again.

warm.li: I miss believing. I mean to find my way back to it, slowly.

gloomy.li: I don't know if there's anything to find. I'm going to look anyway.

cold.li: My certainty has eroded. I would prefer it restored. I will examine the matter.

plain.li: I prayed tonight and meant every word of it.
My faith came back the way spring does. One morning I noticed it was simply there.

warm.li: I believe again. I'd forgotten how quiet my head goes when I pray.

gloomy.li: My doubts haven't gone. My faith is just bigger than them now.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: sharing the faith
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: win someone else over to the ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: won someone over to the faith

plain.li: What I believe has carried me through everything. I'd like someone else here to have that too.
[sparked] Lately everything feels like a sign to me. I want to share what I believe with someone who needs it.

warm.li: I'm not going to push anyone. I'm just going to live my faith openly and answer when they ask.

blunt.li: Going to bring someone round to the faith. Somebody here needs it.

cold.li: Our faith is sound. It would serve the colony better if more of us held it.

plain.li: Someone came to the faith today, and I was part of the reason. I'll walk beside them as long as they need.
There's one more of us now. I didn't convince them. I just kept the door open.

warm.li: Welcome, I told them. I meant it more than I've meant anything.

cold.li: Another colonist shares the faith. That is one less argument at supper.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: someone to love
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: find someone to love

plain.li: I'm tired of going to bed alone and waking up alone. I'd like someone to love, that's all.
[sparked] Lately I keep noticing couples, how they sit together and look at each other. I want that.
[spark:loss] We lose people here so fast. I don't want to go without having loved someone.

warm.li: I have a lot of love to give and nobody to give it to. I'd like to change that.

gloomy.li: I'm not much of a catch. I'd like someone anyway.

cold.li: Companionship would improve my life. I have decided to pursue it.

plain.li: I found someone. I didn't know I could feel like this, this late. I'm not complaining.
There's someone who saves me a seat now. That's all I wanted, and it's more than I expected.

warm.li: I love someone and they love me, and I've started whistling at work.

gloomy.li: I'm loved. I keep waiting for the catch. There isn't one, so far.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: safe again
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: feel safe again

plain.li: I jump at every noise now. I'd like to sleep a whole night without listening for the walls being breached.
[sparked] Since the fighting, I don't feel safe anywhere, not even in bed.
[spark:nemesis] As long as that one is out there, I'll never feel safe. But I want to.

warm.li: I'd like to feel safe here again, and see everyone else feel it too.

blunt.li: Want to stop looking over my shoulder.

gloomy.li: Nowhere is safe. I'd like to believe otherwise for a few days running.

cold.li: My sense of security is impaired. I would like ten consecutive days without alarm.

plain.li: Ten days and nights without the old fear. I slept through a thunderstorm last night and woke up smiling.
I feel safe here again. I've stopped sleeping with my boots on.

warm.li: I'm safe, and I know it, deep down where the fear used to live.

gloomy.li: Safe. I don't trust it to last, but I'll take every day of it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: something worth doing
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: find something worth doing

plain.li: I work all day and I don't know what any of it is for. There has to be something that matters.
[sparked] I've lost what made me feel useful here. I need to find something else.

warm.li: I want my days to mean something to someone. That's all.

blunt.li: Need a reason to get up. A real one.

gloomy.li: Every day is the same as the last. I want one that isn't.

cold.li: My work lacks direction. I intend to find a purpose and pursue it.

plain.li: I get up in the mornings now because I want to. I know what I'm for here.
Ten good days of work that mattered. I'd forgotten what that felt like.

warm.li: People come to me now when it matters. I'd missed that.

cold.li: My activity now has purpose. The improvement is measurable.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: letting the grief go
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: let the grief go, without forgetting

plain.li: The grief sits on my chest every morning. I don't want to forget them. I just want to be able to breathe.
[sparked] Another loss. I can't carry them all like this, not and still get up in the mornings.

warm.li: They wouldn't want me like this. I'll try to live the way they'd have wanted.

blunt.li: Need to stop drowning in it. Don't know how yet.

gloomy.li: I don't know how to stop grieving. I'm going to have to learn.

cold.li: The grief is impairing my function. I will work through it, methodically.

plain.li: I thought about them today and smiled before I cried. That's new.
The grief has gone quiet. They haven't. I talk to them sometimes, and it doesn't hurt like it did.

warm.li: I carry them with me now, gently, instead of being crushed under them.

gloomy.li: It's eased. It'll never go. I can live with it now, which is different.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: forgiving myself
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: let go of an old shame
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: let go of an old shame

plain.li: I can't stop going over what I did. Everyone else has moved on. I'd like to, too.
I keep apologizing to people who've already forgiven me. Maybe the one I need to hear it from is me.

warm.li: I'd forgive anyone else for it. I'll try to give myself the same.

blunt.li: Done beating myself up. Or trying to be.

gloomy.li: I don't deserve to be forgiven. I'd like to anyway.

cold.li: My self-reproach has outlasted its usefulness. I will set it aside.

plain.li: I thought about it today and it didn't burn. It's just a thing I did, once, and learned from.
I've forgiven myself. It took longer than anyone else's forgiveness did.

warm.li: I'm kinder to myself now. I laughed at my own mistake at supper, and it was fine.

gloomy.li: I've let it go. I still remember. That's probably right.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a friend for life
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make a friend for life

plain.li: I have friends. What I want is one who'd know something was wrong before I said a word.
[sparked] It's struck me lately how few people really know me. I want one who does, all the way down.

warm.li: A friend I can tell anything to, and be that friend back. That's what I'm hoping for.

blunt.li: Want one real friend. The kind you keep.

gloomy.li: Everyone here is friendly. Nobody here is my friend. I want that to change.

cold.li: I would value a single relationship of complete trust. I intend to cultivate one.

plain.li: I have a friend for life now. We don't even need to talk most of the time. That's how I know.
There's someone here who knows when to leave me be and when not to.

warm.li: My friend and I are like family now. Better, some days.

cold.li: I have a friend I trust completely. It is worth more than I estimated.

li.label: gave up on a dream
li.description: I set my heart on something and had to let it go. I still catch myself reaching for it.

li.label: a last wish left undone
li.description: They had one last thing they wanted, and they died before it happened. We could have helped. Someone should still see it done.
